findings.title: emptyDir volume exceeded its size limit
findings.cause: the pod was evicted because emptyDir volume cache holds more than its 10Mi sizeLimit; Deployment web has 1 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: pod status is Failed, reason Evicted
evidence.detail: Usage of EmptyDir volume "cache" exceeds the limit "10Mi".
evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-5bd8db9957-2flhs -n kd-emptydir-size-limit -o jsonpath='{.status.message}'

findings.fix: Raise the sizeLimit of emptyDir volume cache, or have the app clean up what it writes there. With medium: Memory, what it holds also counts against the containers' memory limits.
